## LeeWay role

Use GStack as an **engineering workflow specialist** beneath LeeWay Context Engineering and governance. Route to the smallest relevant upstream GStack child skill when its runtime is available.

GStack includes host-specific setup, binaries, session state, telemetry, browser tooling, and other runtime behavior. Those instructions do not override LeeWay authority, platform safety, user permissions, or Veritas.

Do not install GStack, run setup, enable telemetry, write external state, or execute its binaries without the permissions required by the active environment. If the runtime is unavailable, the adapter may use accessible upstream skill guidance as reference, but must not claim GStack executed.

State until a real GStack runtime is verified: `REFERENCE_RUNTIME_ADAPTER`.
